bounded_conclusions: At the preregistered active-drainage reference and 1e-8 m symmetric pair, the accepted whole-window storage derivative and bottom-outward exchange derivative are equal and opposite to reported precision.
The resulting non-bottom derivative J_S+J_R is zero at this local scale even though drainage is active in the fixture.
The production predictor u is about 0.58 percent larger than the local accepted-corrector storage derivative; equality is therefore not exact in this fixture.
This result does not prove drainage is generally head-insensitive. It is local to the frozen window, staging and symmetric pair.
forbidden_inference: Do not identify production u with exact physical storage under active drainage.
Do not infer zero drainage sensitivity outside this local frozen corrector window.
Do not change production drainage staging or coupling ownership from this result alone.
